_comment: 017-edge-protection — Cache Rules (contracts/edge-config.md « Rules », research R8–R10). Page HTML is never cached in lot 1 (FR-009): every host that is not an image, asset or internal host is a page host — client www. custom hostnames included — and bypasses the cache except /_next/static/ (hashed, immutable). Lot 3 replaces the bypass rule.

rules.expression: not http.host in {{{NON_PAGE_HOSTS}}} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/")

rules.description: Images (imgproxy): cache, origin TTL, two variants per URL (WebP / original)
Assets (media files, fonts): cache, origin TTL (immutable, keys never reused)
